# epm:plan-critique v1 — Claude `critic`, round 1 on plan v2

**Verdict: REVISE** (1 Must-Fix, 3 non-blocking concerns). Codex twin: no-show
(quota sentinel live until 2026-09-05), so this is the single review of record.

## Must-Fix (accepted in full; plan v3 addresses it)

**The casefold sweep does not close the crash class the Goal names.** Plan v2
asserted that `re.IGNORECASE` performs full Unicode case folding and that
`.casefold()` therefore reproduces the regex's own fold. **Both claims are
false**, verified independently against the installed interpreter:

- `re` performs SIMPLE case folding + extended pairs, not full folding:
  `re.fullmatch("ss", "ß", re.I)` → False, `re.fullmatch("fi", "ﬁ", re.I)` →
  False, while `re.fullmatch("s", "ſ", re.I)` and
  `re.fullmatch("i", "İ", re.I)` → True.
- For **U+0130 İ** the folds AGREE with each other and DISAGREE with the
  regex: `"İ".lower() == "İ".casefold() == "i̇"` (2 chars), while `re` folds
  it to the single char `i`.

Consequence — measured against the unmodified module, post-casefold:

- `:16819` `"sİx same-issue follow-up rounds"` → matched, `.casefold()` →
  `"si̇x"` → `_NUMBER_WORDS.get` → None → `int("si̇x")` → **`ValueError`**.
- `:10635` `"one poİnt per seed"` → matched, `.casefold()` → `"poi̇nt"` →
  `_BEAT_WORD_TO_KIND["poi̇nt"]` → **`KeyError`**.

The driver is a bare comprehension with no per-check `except` (`:18721`), so
either raise crashes the ENTIRE verifier. A casefold-only fix would have
shipped green with the Goal's "cannot crash the whole verifier" claim FALSE at
both crash sites.

**Also: `:10635` was misclassified.** v2 called it "not currently reachable"
because the alternation `bar|point|dot|marker|line|curve` contains no `s`.
That argument is `ſ`-specific — `point` / `line` contain `i`, so `poİnt`
reaches the site TODAY (measured above).

**Resolution in v3:** keep part (i), the 26-site casefold sweep (still correct;
it closes the `ſ` / `µ` class), and ADD part (ii) — make both crash-class
consumers TOTAL (`.get` + skip-on-miss at `:10635`; resolve-then-`isdecimal`-
guarded-`int` else skip at `:16820`). v3 §3.3 argues why a site-level total
lookup is NOT the declined body scope item 3 (a driver-level `except` would
swallow arbitrary future defects into a degraded PASS; a total lookup catches
nothing and gives an unresolvable token the same disposition as a token that
never matched). §2 and §11 row 1 are rewritten with the measured
simple-vs-full fold table. The `İ` arms are added as pins at both sites.

**One deliberate divergence from the critic's suggested fix:** the guard is
`str.isdecimal()`, not `str.isdigit()`. `"²".isdigit()` is True while
`int("²")` raises, so an `isdigit()` guard reintroduces the same crash at a
lower rate; `isdecimal()` is exactly Unicode Nd — what `\d` matches and what
`int()` accepts (measured on `7` / `٣` / `１` / `²`). This also means the
reference fix `0403597c73` carries the `²` hole in its own `isdigit()` guard.

Exhaustive enumeration of the fold-divergence class, run over ALL 1,114,112
codepoints. This replaces plan v3 §12's assumption ("`İ` is the only
fold-divergence class reachable by the file's ASCII alternations") with a
measured, closed result — and finds a SECOND member the round-1 critic did not.

## Result 1 — the divergence class has exactly TWO members

Characters that `re.IGNORECASE` matches against an ASCII letter but whose
`.casefold()` does NOT produce that letter (so a captured token misses an
ASCII-keyed dict):

| Codepoint | Name | `re.I` matches | `.casefold()` | `.lower()` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| U+0130 | LATIN CAPITAL LETTER I WITH DOT ABOVE | `i` | `i̇` (2 ch) | `i̇` (2 ch) |
| U+0131 | LATIN SMALL LETTER DOTLESS I | `i` | `ı` (1 ch) | `ı` (1 ch) |

**TOTAL: 2.** Round 1 found U+0130; **U+0131 `ı` is a second, independent
member** — `sıx same-issue follow-up rounds` and `one poınt per seed` are
additional live crash inputs at the same two sites. Both are Turkish-alphabet
characters, i.e. plausible in a body written or pasted by a Turkish-locale
tool, not merely adversarial.

This is exactly why part (ii) is a TOTAL LOOKUP and not per-character
handling: a per-character fix keyed on `İ` alone would still crash on `ı`, and
nothing structural distinguishes the two. Totality covers both plus any future
Unicode addition.

## Result 2 — part (i)'s value at the ASCII-alternation crash sites is ONE char

Characters that `.lower()` misses but `.casefold()` FIXES, in the
ASCII-letter-matching context: **exactly 1 — U+017F LATIN SMALL LETTER LONG S**
(`ſ` → `s`).

**Correction to plan v3 §2's table:** the `µ` U+00B5 row is wrong as written.
The table's column asks "does `re.I` match it against ASCII?", and `µ` folds to
GREEK SMALL LETTER MU (U+03BC) — which is NOT ASCII. So `µ` cannot be captured
by any of this file's ASCII-only alternations and is OUT of the crash class.
It remains valid only as the weaker observation that full-folding characters do
reach committed bodies (`tasks/completed/1967/body.md`). Plan v4 will state
part (i)'s realized crash-class value precisely as one character, with the
broader justification resting on cross-site consistency and the ratchetability
of the invariant (v3 §3.2 reasons 2 and 3), not on a large fixed-character set.

## Result 3 — the `isdecimal()` guard is airtight in both directions

- 660 codepoints are `isdecimal()`; **all 660** are matched by `\d` in a str
  pattern (no `\d`-matchable decimal escapes the guard).
- **0 of 660** are rejected by `int()`.
- 4,900 sampled two-character `isdecimal` pairs (the alternation is `\d{1,2}`,
  so a 2-char capture is reachable, including mixed-script pairs):
  **0 rejected by `int()`**.

So `str.isdecimal()` has no hole in either direction, whereas `str.isdigit()`
admits `²` which `int()` rejects. The v3 §3.3 guard choice is confirmed, and
the reference fix `0403597c73`'s `isdigit()` hole is confirmed real.

## Disposition

Folds into plan v4 together with critic round 2's findings (round 2 is
reviewing v3 now; v3 is left in place until it returns so the review is not
reading a file that moves underneath it). New test arms for v4: `sıx` (U+0131)
at `:16819` and `one poınt per seed` at `:10635`, alongside the existing `ſix`
/ `sİx` / `poİnt` / `²` arms.
